scope: Deterministic decoded-RGB preprocessing for the candidate NSFL ONNX graph; not yet connected to the app worker
implemented: Added pure TypeScript 224x224 bilinear preprocessing with separable antialias filtering, 22-bit filter coefficients and byte rounding after each pass. It emits NCHW float32 values in 0..255 without repeating normalization already inside the ONNX graph.

Matches Pillow 13's adaptive horizontal/vertical pass order. Initial unconditional horizontal-first behavior failed three independent reference cases; implementation was corrected, not the expected hashes.
Input dimensions, byte length, 4-million-pixel maximum and 8192-per-axis limits are checked before intermediate allocation. The source array is not modified.

Reference generator uses actual installed Pillow 13.0.0 on deterministic synthetic RGB, emitting only hashes. No user images, network or photo fixtures are used. Checked-in expected hashes keep normal tests independent of Python/Pillow installation.

verification.detail: Actual Pillow 13.0.0 generated fourteen independent RGB and NCHW byte hashes covering 1x1, one-pixel axes, identity size, upsampling, mixed/downsampling, odd dimensions and 2048x1024 input.

All fourteen resized RGB hashes and little-endian NCHW float32 hashes exactly match the independent reference. Additional tests verify channel order, 0..255 values, source preservation and malformed/pathological dimensions.

verification.command: Production TypeScript preprocessing plus actual candidate ONNX/WASM inference
verification.detail: Node imported the actual production .ts module, prepared deterministic 640x480 RGB, verified NCHW hash e019c4b8c311e85666548fc076c8bb2c1f00535180337039b855993e70ec1d15 against Pillow, verified candidate model hash, and executed real ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 WASM inference.

verification.command: Client TypeScript project build and targeted ESLint

verification.detail: 1.03s; existing dynamic-import/chunk-size warnings remain. The new NSFL preprocessor is not yet invoked by application media components.

single_synthetic_chain_observation.limitations: One synthetic decoded-RGB tensor, not accuracy, peak performance, encoded-image decode parity, browser or Windows app acceptance.

remaining: Versioned ONNX Runtime Web integration, self-hosted/hash-checked model and runtime assets, license/attribution packaging, and actual worker/policy/UI integration.
Encoded-image decoding parity, transparency/ICC/orientation handling, representative NSFL/threshold evaluation, browser/CSP and packaged Windows acceptance.

The model card does not pin Pillow; this implementation explicitly targets Pillow 13. Earlier Pillow releases may use a different pass order and must not be claimed byte-identical without verification.
acceptance: Not accepted. Preprocessing and a real synthetic inference chain are verified. The application still keeps disturbing classification unknown until integration and its acceptance gates are satisfied. No production release performed.
